title: Zoom blocked by the viewport meta tag
user_impact: Users with low vision lose content when zooming in.

checks.source: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text; CSS Device Adaptation / viewport meta 'parsing the content attribute'
checks.applicability: meta name=viewport elements of the document (also when inserted by script).
checks.expectation:
Fails at the meta element when it disables zooming (user-scalable=no or 0)
or caps maximum-scale below 2, which prevents resizing text to 200 percent.
Values are parsed as browsers do: comma, semicolon or whitespace separate
pairs, whitespace around '=' belongs to the pair, case does not matter.
maximum-scale=1.9 fails, 2 does not (that is zoom/viewport-scale-limited).
No viewport meta at all is zoom/viewport-missing, not this id.

failing.html:
Page with a zoom-disabling viewport meta tag

The viewport meta tag above sets user-scalable=no.
